entries.stanceLine: No clean edge — mixed signals — 115% of a typical day's range is already spent — fresh breakouts have little fuel; favour fades back into the range over chasing.

signals.text: 115% of a typical day's range is already spent — fresh breakouts have little fuel; favour fades back into the range over chasing.

Past 13:30 with US futures +0.55% — the 14:30 US handoff argues for holding longs into the US open.
GBP is a crowded short — a short-squeeze higher in sterling is a latent slap for upside breaks (strong GBP weighs on FTSE).
